author: Myeongjin Kang
inspection: Full source displayed and reviewed before execution. verify.py reads with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW; never opens output files, invokes subprocesses, mutates paths or uses network. Required external anchor checked before first package JSON parse; seal authenticates manifest bytes before payload interpretation. guard.py authenticates verifier code before compile, counts JSON parses, denies file writes, process/network calls and filesystem mutations during verifier execution.
limits: Inspection and runtime guard concern integrity and side effects, not proof truth.
